title: Wear App stops connecting/synchronizing after installing 3.0.0.2-dev-j  Commit#3d9b08e5 (compatibility break?)
body:
**AndroidAPS 3.0.0.2-dev-j**
**Build:** #3d9b08e5
**Flavor**: Fullrelease

**Watch**: Samsung Galaxy Watch4 44mm
_Wear App_: 2022.02.14 (Release version)
Build: #B1D45833C

**Problem description:**
With installing this build the Android Wear app stopped synchronizing.
APPS was updated at about 18:30h

App seems to not be connected,
Wear->RESEND DATA and Wear->OPEN SETTINGS ON WEAR have no effect.

![Screenshot_20220505_213846_sysui](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/45144129/167013609-3bccada6-f04f-4f81-a54b-22185c57bdac.png)

![Screenshot_20220505_214022_androidaps](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/45144129/167013629-3b1e9bc5-eeee-4857-859c-ecc4bc61bd29.png)

** Log files **
[AndroidAPS_LOG_1651779641963.log.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/8635517/AndroidAPS_LOG_1651779641963.log.zip)

comments.body: You have to update also Wear.

Expecting dev being compatible with release version. 
Apparently, it is not?
Not compatible in this case. There is some big reorganosation inside Wear dev-j.
I have both AAPS and Wear updated into dev-j but there seems to be mysterious problems what I do not understand. Could you update your systen and comment is it working without problems.

i see crashes comming from OnePlus Nord2 5G
caused by too old Wear OS

Upgraded Wear App to current dev. Yes, it is now showing syncing/BG.

Unfortunately for this version:

- Tiles are no longer functioning
- Watch faces layouts have "problems" (especially my favorite: "DigitalStyle")
- Watch settings (double screen-tap, settings) crashes when scrolling down)

So, seems to be a work in progress...

> caused by too old Wear OS

Well, In my case an almost brand new Samsung Galaxy Watch4. Was working perfectly with tiles and all control functions.
Came sort of as a surprise as I expected release version of the Wear app to stay compatible.
tiles fixed, the rest is working well for me

> tiles fixed, the rest is working well for me

Ah, that's great!
Will test tomorrow and let you know my findings

**Tiles**:

Only the "Action" tile is now fixed, other two tiles do nothing

**On UI:

I am using same Watch face AAPS(digitalStyle)**
Looks like UI is getting somewhat better now (layout may have been affected by database reset). But is off on some parts.

- I can display date, including day name (as in THU, 5 MAY, 23:52) and week number
It shows "52" (should be day name) and "52 MAY" (date)". Day name and date show "minutes?"

- Arrow on BG complication is not showing (something seems to be there)

- BG complication shows "5." and then below something that looks like part of "3"

- IOB Compilation is not showing correctly

- Watch face settings (double-tap menue) crashes when scrolling to end

![Screenshot_20220505_235635_sysui](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/45144129/167032674-e0b30ce2-8441-4d05-b988-4b1cbeafa6d6.png)

- Always on is also affected.

![20220505_235925](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/45144129/167032586-bbd7684b-d39b-48c3-a9a5-af87314957fe.jpg)
